resources.string: Estimate a sustained single note from microphone input.

Single sustained tones approximately 65–1000 Hz only. Fixed A4 = 440 Hz, 12-tone equal temperament. Noise, harmonics, microphone processing and device accuracy affect estimates; this is not calibrated or polyphonic analysis.
Tap Start, grant microphone permission, then tap Start again. Play one steady note. Stop or leave the screen to end capture.
A steady 440 Hz tone corresponds to A4 near zero cents.
No stable detection is shown for silence, weak or unsuitable signals. Confidence is only a periodicity heuristic, not an accuracy guarantee. No audio is saved.
